text:
lina: Heads-up: EU PrivEdge asked to decommission bastions and move to VPN + ephemeral certs. They want equivalent isolation guarantees but less ops. Can we sketch risks for RBAC, KMS, and audit?

omar: big change. primary concerns: CA lifecycle for VPN certs, how we attest ephemeral identities to KMS, and preventing metadata-server key theft.

lina: customer requirement: no long-lived jumpboxes, no ssh-agent forwarding, must be able to prove "no lateral access" and full forensic trail.

jin: quick notes: 1) issue per-cluster/customer KEK (HSM-backed if available) 2) node agents use workload identity to request short-lived DEKs 3) DEKs cached in memory for a short TTL (2-10m) with strict LRU eviction 4) kube-apiserver audit + KMS audit must have a shared correlation id for every unwrap.

sec-robot: checklist added to PR 4021: kms-audit-header, vpn-ca-rotation, netpol-ejection, rbac-ephemeral.

jin: example NetworkPolicy idea (deny egress by default, allow only CA, KMS, SIEM and internal infra ranges). using calico annotations to allow FQDNs for managed kms endpoints: 

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: privedge-egress-default-deny
  annotations:
    projectcalico.org/AllowFQDNs: "kms.eu.example.com,ca.privedge.internal"
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.20.0.0/16 # infra plane
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 172.16.0.0/24 # metrics + sidecar
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 9125
```

jin: also make explicit iptables rule on nodes to DROP requests to cloud metadata endpoint to avoid token harvest.

omar: on KMS audit: require structured headers on unwrap calls: `x-rw-cluster`, `x-rw-tenant`, `x-rw-pod`, `x-rw-ephemeral-id`. Ship these to a write-once SIEM index. Consider signing each event with a signing key to detect tamper.

lina: correlation: how do we map user auth to pod action? If ephemeral role bindings are created on login, include the ephemeral-binding id in kube-audit records.

jin: yes - our auth service should mint an ephemeral roleBinding token with an ID we put in both the kube-audit and the KMS header. That lets investigators pivot user->pod->kms unwrap.

omar: performance: model-serving may need many unwrappings. solution: envelope encryption + short-lived DEK cache in memory on the serving process. KMS only unwraps the DEK, not each request.

lina: migration plan for RBAC: 1) enable ephemeral role creation in dev 2) test in staging with telemetry 3) rollout to prod canary (5% nodes) 4) full rollout. Auto-teardown rule: if ephemeral-binding shows zero api-server activity after 48h, controller can GC it (OPA policy controlled). Need manual override.

jin: I'll draft an OPA policy and a controller that annotates roleBindings with `rw:ephemeral-id` and TTL. Controller logs every creation/deletion to audit.

omar: vuln triage notes: if ephemeral creds leak, blast radius limited by TTL + per-tenant KEKs. Add emergency rotate play: revoke KEK, rotate DEKs, roll serving pods with new DEK. Must be scripted.

infra-bot: created runbook: https://runbooks.internal/priv/vpn-no-bastion-revoke-rotate - includes SIEM queries, rotation steps, and post-incident timeline template.

lina: audit retention: propose SIEM write-once index retention options 90/365/1095 days per customer SLA. Also keep a tamper-evidence checksum chain for KMS events.

jin: ops note: block ssh-agent forwarding in the VPN cert profile and harden SSH config on nodes to `AuthenticationMethods publickey` only.

omar: one more: require attestation from node-agent before giving DEK: node-agent must prove node integrity (e.g., signed node-id + bootstrap-token ephemeral).

lina: next steps: jin - open infra PR with netpol + OPA policy + KMS header schema. omar - sketch HSM KEK per-tenant model and failure modes. I'll prepare a 1-page customer summary and schedule review with EU PrivEdge.

deploy-bot: security-checklist flagged on PR 4021: action required.

lina: thanks all. keeping this thread as the audit record — will attach the 1-pager to the PR once ready. :lock:
